paper_ref: Loh and Warachka, forthcoming in Management Science, October 2011
economic_intuition: PEAD is concentrated within streaks: investors underreact most when a large positive or negative earnings surprise extends an existing streak.
detailed_definition: Sort stocks into SURP magnitude quintiles by the most recent earnings surprise, then buy positive streaks in the largest SURP quintile and sell negative streaks in the smallest SURP quintile.

source_details: stock price at the end of the prior month

required_fields.concept: I/B/E/S actual quarterly earnings used in SURP.
Most recent mean consensus analyst forecast for the quarter.
required_fields.source_detail: SURP uses the most recent mean consensus forecast of analysts for the quarter.

required_fields.concept: Stock price at the end of the prior month, adjusted to same per-share basis as SURP.
required_fields.source_detail: SURP is normalized by the firm’s stock price on CRSP at the end of the prior month.

required_fields.concept: CRSP share code used to restrict to ordinary shares 10 or 11.
required_fields.source_detail: Monthly returns are obtained from CRSP for stocks classified as ordinary shares (share codes 10 or 11).

required_fields.concept: Book-to-market ratio required to be non-negative.
required_fields.source_detail: Firms in the sample are required to have a non-negative book-to-market ratio.

required_fields.concept: Lagged stock price used for the below-five-dollar trading-strategy exclusion.
required_fields.source_detail: Trading strategies exclude firms whose lagged stock prices are below five dollars.

required_fields.concept: Monthly return used for calendar-time portfolio returns.
required_fields.source_detail: Monthly returns are obtained from CRSP.

required_fields.concept: Delisting return added to monthly return, with Shumway convention when missing and performance-related.
required_fields.source_detail: Delisting returns are added from the CRSP delisting file.

required_fields.concept: Risk-free rate used to form excess returns in factor regressions; paper does not name a separate source in the table caption.
required_fields.source_detail: Monthly returns less the risk-free rate are regressed on factor models.

required_fields.concept: Prior quarterly SURP signs used to identify streaks and reversals.
required_fields.source_detail: Streaks require consecutive earnings surprises with the same sign.

required_fields.concept: Derived monthly quintile rank of the most recent earnings surprise magnitude; not a raw input field.
required_fields.source_detail: Firms are sorted into SURP portfolios according to the quintile rank of the most recent SURP; derive from SURP_q each month.

formula.expression: long_leg = streak_sign_m == +1 and SURP_quintile_m == 5; short_leg = streak_sign_m == -1 and SURP_quintile_m == 1
formula.paper_expression: Buy positive streaks in highest SURP quintile; sell negative streaks in lowest SURP quintile
